$comment: Kua numbers, groups and the eight directions. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

blocks.kua.1: Kua 1 belongs to the element water and the East group. It favours calm, flow and communication; the north is its home direction.
blocks.kua.2: Kua 2 belongs to the element earth and the West group. It favours stability, care and partnership; the south-west is its home direction.
blocks.kua.3: Kua 3 belongs to the element wood and the East group. It favours growth, new starts and family; the east is its home direction.
blocks.kua.4: Kua 4 belongs to the element wood and the East group. It favours wisdom, learning and prosperity; the south-east is its home direction.
blocks.kua.6: Kua 6 belongs to the element metal and the West group. It favours leadership, mentors and helpful people; the north-west is its home direction.
blocks.kua.7: Kua 7 belongs to the element metal and the West group. It favours joy, creativity and children; the west is its home direction.
blocks.kua.8: Kua 8 belongs to the element earth and the West group. It favours knowledge, stillness and steady growth; the north-east is its home direction.
blocks.kua.9: Kua 9 belongs to the element fire and the East group. It favours recognition, reputation and energy; the south is its home direction.
blocks.kua.group.east: East group (Kua 1, 3, 4, 9): the north, south, east and south-east suit you best. Other East group people share your good directions.
blocks.kua.group.west: West group (Kua 2, 6, 7, 8): the west, north-west, south-west and north-east suit you best. Other West group people share your good directions.
blocks.kua.direction.success: Success: the best direction for wealth, career and important decisions. Face it at your desk or in meetings when you can.
blocks.kua.direction.health: Health: the direction for well-being and vitality. A good choice for the bedroom or for where you exercise.
blocks.kua.direction.relationships: Relationships: the direction for love, family and harmony. Use it for the living room or where the family gathers.
blocks.kua.direction.growth: Personal growth: the direction for peace, study and self-development. Good for study, prayer or meditation.
blocks.kua.direction.mishaps: Mishaps: a direction that tradition links with small annoyances. Avoid facing it for important work; a storeroom here is fine.
blocks.kua.direction.five_ghosts: Five ghosts: tradition links it with quarrels and unsettled energy. Keep it calm and avoid sleeping with your head toward it.
blocks.kua.direction.six_killings: Six killings: tradition links it with setbacks in work and relationships. Avoid it for the main door or desk where you can.
blocks.kua.direction.total_loss: Total loss: the least favourable direction in tradition. Avoid it for the main door, bed and desk; use it for storage or bathrooms.
